visualCharacteristics.layout: Two columns on desktop (text left, media right, top-aligned); stacked on mobile with text first

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: first cell text (H2 and paragraphs with links), second cell one or more stacked images

usage: Use for an 'about' style section where long copy sits next to one or more stacked images.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for text + stacked media layouts. Source order is preserved on mobile (text first), unlike the base columns block which lifts image-only columns to the top.
